summary: Comprehensive testing of iteration 117: Sequential notifications (4 levels), email templates CRUD, suggested contacts, attach matrix, 1000 char message limit, and email detail in bitácora. All 18 backend tests passed. Frontend testing verified all new UI components working correctly.

minor.issue: Parameter name conflict with FastAPI - 'body' parameter caused 422 error. Fixed by renaming to 'body_content'.

critical_code_review_comments: Router order in server.py was causing route conflicts - projects_router now registered before seed_templates_router to ensure new email-templates CRUD routes take precedence
seed_data_creation: Used existing projects prj_38a0b2e9d3b5 (multistore, notified). Created test email templates during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 117 complete. Sequential notifications now use 4 levels: Primera Comunicación, Primer Recordatorio, Segundo Recordatorio, Tercer Recordatorio. Each level must be executed in order (validates that previous level was sent). Banks require client Primera Comunicación first. Email templates CRUD uses FormData with 'body_content' parameter for PUT endpoint. Message limit increased from 500 to 1000 chars. Bitácora entries auto-created with email_detail for both sequential notifications and ad-hoc emails. 'Ver Correo' button shows full email content.
